# The OrgAgents profiles

The platform's model is a set of UML profiles, one per concern (ADR-0101, ADR-0112). The profiles are authoritative for what the model means; `spec/model.py` and `spec/binding.py` realise them and are held equal to them by `tests/test_metamodel_completeness.py`. These pages and the `.puml` diagrams beside them are generated.

| Profile | Imports | Stereotypes | DataTypes | Enumerations | Relationships | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Core](core.md) | UML | 4 | 2 | 6 | 0 | 13 |
| [Organisation](organisation.md) | Core | 8 | 2 | 7 | 27 | 70 |
| [Authority](authority.md) | Core, Organisation | 3 | 3 | 3 | 8 | 29 |
| [Access](access.md) | Core, Organisation, Authority | 5 | 1 | 5 | 15 | 37 |
| [Data](data.md) | Core, Organisation, Access | 2 | 0 | 3 | 15 | 21 |
| [Knowledge](knowledge.md) | Core, Organisation, Data | 5 | 4 | 4 | 21 | 51 |
| [Process](process.md) | Core, Organisation, Authority, Data | 6 | 5 | 7 | 38 | 47 |
| [Assurance](assurance.md) | Core, Organisation, Data, Process | 3 | 8 | 10 | 13 | 71 |
| [Deployment](deployment.md) | Core, Organisation, Authority, Access, Data, Knowledge, Process, Assurance | 3 | 5 | 0 | 11 | 89 |
